senses.gloss: m. (קבט; cmp. קבץ, v. חבט a. denomin., esp. חוּבְטָא) a vessel containing pressed or pickled substances, pressing pot.—Pl. קְבוּטִין.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:2:4">Y. Ter. X, 47ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ק׳ של מורייס</he> pots of pickle (v. <cite ref="M00650"><he>מוּרְיָיס</he></cite>).—V. <cite ref="S00045"><he>קָבוּת</he></cite>; <cite ref="S00222"><he>קוּבְטָאוֹת</he></cite>.
